clue.text: Weak lack resolve for easily accomplished task

clue.text: This gin certainly doesn't sound like a quick one

definitions.text: This gin certainly doesn't sound like a quick one

parts.words: This gin certainly doesn't sound like a quick one

clue.text: Reach a remarkable Titan

clue.text: One might need a rest during this game
